text: To prepare delectable meals, home cooks must first develop their culinary skills. Key to this process is the mastery of two fundamental ingredients: onions and garlic. Both are versatile and can be seamlessly integrated into a wide range of dishes, from soups and stews to stir-fries and salads. Their unique flavor profiles complement one another, adding layers of depth and richness to meals. As a result, onions and garlic form the backbone of many cuisines, enhancing and elevating dishes with their distinctive aromatic flavors.
